verdict.rationale: Persona documents Cases, a configurable operations UI with SLAs, resolution analytics and automations, and it emits webhooks when an inquiry requires further review. Workflows can route or tag borderline inquiries, and Accounts consolidate a user's history. The evidence does not show the review screen presenting document images, extracted fields and check results together, or reviewer decisions being written back to the inquiry or account record. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the full evidence view in the review queue (images, extracted fields, check results), documented feedback of reviewer decisions into the record, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
